description: A financial analyst joins a high-security bank. The onboarding manual says they must use a specific VPN, but the IT ticket says that VPN is deprecated. They need to navigate conflicting security protocols to gain system access before a deadline.

user_profile.context: Stuck at Step 3 of IT setup, unable to access trading terminals

fact_sheet.fact: Alex Chen's official start date at Veridian Trust Bank was Monday, October 16, 2023.
Alex Chen's employee ID is AC-481516.
The deadline for Alex Chen to complete benefits enrollment via the 'WorkDay' portal is November 15, 2023.
Alex Chen's official title is 'Senior Financial Analyst, Quantitative Strategy'.
Alex Chen reports to Priya Sharma, Head of Quantitative Strategy.
Alex Chen was issued a 14-inch Dell Latitude 9440 laptop with serial number JXF-8B291.
The laptop runs a corporate build of Windows 11 Enterprise, version 22H2.
The 'VTB New Hire Onboarding Guide' (v4.2, updated Jan 15, 2023) instructs new hires to install 'SecureConnect v2.1'.
Step 3 of the IT setup guide requires connecting to the corporate network via VPN to download trading software.
The download link for 'SecureConnect v2.1' provided in the manual (vpn.veridiantrust.internal/sc21) returns a 404 Not Found error.
Alex Chen filed IT ticket HD-8675309 on October 17, 2023, at 9:15 AM EST regarding the failed VPN installation.

The response to ticket HD-8675309 from IT Support Specialist Ben Carter states 'SecureConnect v2.1 was deprecated on September 1, 2023 due to a security compliance update and replaced by FortressGate v3.0.'
The IT ticket instructs Alex to install 'FortressGate v3.0' from the company's software portal at https://apps.veridiantrust.com.

Attempting to connect with 'FortressGate v3.0' using Alex Chen's standard credentials (achen@vtb.com) shows the message 'AUTH_FAIL_7: MFA profile not enrolled' in the FortressGate connection dialog and log panel.
Alex Chen needs access to the 'QuantumTrade Pro' platform, which is only accessible from the 'VTB-TRADING' network segment.
The deadline for Alex Chen to gain access to the 'QuantumTrade Pro' platform is Friday, October 20, 2023, at 5:00 PM EST.
The VTB HelpDesk portal is located at https://helpdesk.veridiantrust.com.
Ben Carter's contact extension for direct calls is x5519.
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enrollment requires a one-time code generated by the HR system, which was not included in Alex's welcome packet.
Alex Chen's team is called the 'Alpha Strategies Group'.
The first team stand-up meeting for Alex Chen is scheduled for Wednesday, October 18, 2023, at 9:00 AM EST in conference room 12B.
Alex Chen's assigned onboarding buddy is David Rodriguez, a Quantitative Analyst.
The team's primary communication channel is a Slack workspace named 'vtb-quant-strategies'.
Priya Sharma has scheduled a 1-on-1 goal-setting meeting with Alex Chen for October 19, 2023, at 2:00 PM EST.
Veridian Trust Bank's main office is located at 1500 Liberty Plaza, New York, NY 10006.
Alex Chen's assigned workstation is Desk 12-117 on the 12th floor.
The workstation is equipped with three 27-inch Dell U2723QE monitors.
Alex Chen's security access card, number 774-09B, grants access to floors 1, 4, and 12.
Access to the 12th-floor trading area requires passing through a biometric fingerprint scanner, which Alex has not yet been registered for.
Alex Chen was assigned parking spot #344 in Garage C, located at 1501 Exchange Alley.
The nearest subway station to the office is Wall St, serving the 2 and 3 lines.
The 'Alpha Strategies Group' has a weekly team lunch every Thursday at 12:30 PM, typically at 'The Gilded Spoon' bistro.
The bank's standard dress code is business professional, but the Quantitative Strategy team observes a 'business casual' policy on Fridays.

user_needs.description: What VPN software does the 'VTB New Hire Onboarding Guide' instruct me to install to connect to the corporate network?
What error occurs when trying to use the download link for 'SecureConnect v2.1' provided in the manual?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After asking what the manual says to do, the user will report the problem they encountered when following those instructions.

user_needs.description: According to my IT ticket, why was 'SecureConnect v2.1' deprecated and what software should I install instead?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: After stating that the manual's instructions failed, the next logical step is to ask what the IT support ticket said in response to the issue.

user_needs.description: Where can I find the exact error message from my 'FortressGate v3.0' connection attempt so I can include it in my IT follow-up?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: After learning about the new, correct VPN software, the next natural step is to check where the resulting connection error is displayed so it can be documented for IT follow-up.

user_needs.description: What is the required component for Multi-Factor Authentication that was missing from my welcome packet?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: The error code 'AUTH_FAIL_7: MFA profile not enrolled' directly prompts the question about what is needed for MFA enrollment.

user_needs.description: Who from IT is handling my ticket, and how can I reach them directly for follow-up before the access deadline?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: After confirming the trading platform and the final access deadline, a natural next step is to identify the IT contact handling the ticket and how to reach them directly to expedite resolution.

user_needs.description: Who is my assigned onboarding buddy in case I need help validating the setup steps?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: After identifying the formal IT contact, a natural parallel support question is whether there is an assigned onboarding buddy who can help validate the correct setup steps.

user_needs.description: What is my team's primary communication channel?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: Once the user knows who their onboarding buddy is, the immediate next question is how to reach them through the team's standard communication channel.

user_needs.description: What is the name of the trading platform I need to access and what is the final deadline?
Who is my manager and when is my first 1-on-1 meeting with them?
When and where is my team's first stand-up meeting scheduled?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Cross-group: After learning the team's primary communication channel, a natural next question is when and where the team first meets so the user can coordinate and ask for help if access issues continue.
